heroSub: Le Continental Sea Palace, at the entrance of the Mehdia seafront. Ten full breakfast sets, a sushi bar, wood-fired pizza and house pastries — facing the Atlantic, from the first coffee to dinner.
p1d: Terrace facing the open ocean at the entrance of the seafront. The best angle on the Mehdia sunset.
p2d: From Sabah Fes to Norvégien Light: complete sets, hot drink, juice and water included.
p3d: Fish prepared to order — the only counter of its kind on the seafront.
bfSub: Every set is served complete: the plate, a hot drink, orange or carrot juice and mineral water. Served all morning, facing the sea.
